# Card Header

## Summary
The header strip of a card: identity, type icon, and the card's own controls.

## Shape
Keeps the title, the type icon and card-level actions in one arrangement so headers stay
recognizable across unrelated cards, with the controls supplied as yielded blocks. It also owns
truncation, which is the part that goes wrong when a header is hand-rolled: a long title has to
clip rather than push the actions off the edge. Mounting this is why the header of a card you
have never seen still behaves the way the last one did.

## Usage
Rendered in its states by the freestyle usage page at `packages/boxel-ui/src/components/card-header/usage.gts`.

```gts
import { CardHeader } from '@cardstack/boxel-ui/components';
```
